description: This file contains functions and constants related to filtering and selecting code snippets for autocomplete features, including token management, snippet shuffling, and prioritization logic.

methods.name: getRemainingTokenCount
methods.description: Calculates remaining tokens based on helper variables and options.

methods.name: shuffleArray
methods.description: Shuffles an array in place using the Fisher-Yates algorithm.

methods.name: filterSnippetsAlreadyInCaretWindow
methods.description: Filters out snippets already present in the caret window.
